report_summary: The report develops a careful shared-memory and side-effect argument, preserving alternate deployment explanations, uncertain external outcomes and a bounded API-key caveat. It correctly distinguishes the administrator role annotation from the deletion label, but calls cumulative welcome-page history a reached page size and occasionally turns proposed counter workflows into realized effects.
